text:
Work is recorded where the event happens; there is no log file, and where we are is computed (`warrant status`, `git log`, `gh pr list`, `gh issue list`, skill `slice`). A task of a Change is `[x]` in `tasks.md`; a cancelled or moved task is removed, with an `I-N` row giving the reason and a link. Work without a Change is a commit and a PR that touches no policy path (`.warrant/local/**`, `.warrant/warrant.lock.json`, `.github/workflows/**`); one that does is a Change.

Issues. LATTICE debt outside the current Change (a defect, an idea, something deferred) is a GitHub issue the agent opens itself and names in its report; in code `#N`. Title `<prefix>: <what>` (`s0`…`s4`, `sw`, `design`, `infra`); body "Why:" a source link, "Where:" the Change, slice or trigger; a Change issue also "Depends on:", in the milestone of its slice — or of the slice it unblocks, else in none. Labels: one type — `bug` · `enhancement` · `question` — and one priority — `P1` blocks the slice or the honesty of the process · `P2` before the slice closes · `P3` some day. A process failure is an issue labelled `process` with "Root cause" and "Prevention", opened by the session that sees it.

Closing, the first that applies: a Change issue by its archive-PR (`Closes #N` there, not in the spec- or impl-PR); a `process` issue when its prevention is in place as a rule, a test or a setting, not when the failure is fixed; a `question` by the maintainer's answer, linked; any other issue by the PR that fixes it (`Closes #N` there). A duplicate gets the label `duplicate` and a link; a refusal the label `wontfix` and the reason. `status.mjs` lists the open issues whose condition looks met; the coordinator closes them.

A WARRANT defect, gap or idea is an issue in `Homasters-max/SRA` the agent opens itself: title `<area>: <what>` (`guard`, `cli`, `ci`, `records`, `docs`), one label `bug` · `enhancement` · `question`, body "Found in:" a LATTICE link and the WARRANT version, "What happened", "Expected" — facts about WARRANT only, the repository is public. It is named `Homasters-max/SRA#N` and linked from the LATTICE issue that waits on it.

Slices. A slice is a GitHub milestone and its umbrella issue: plan, list of Changes, decision log. Each Change is one session in its own worktree, started from its issue; it reads its issue, the `design-next` IDs it implements and the merged specs it depends on, not the context of other Changes. The coordinator session holds the slice — dispatch, review, the queue of the maintainer's acts, decision log (skill `slice`, "Coordinator") — and never writes a Change's code. A red `main` (a failed `test` run on `main`, or `warrant validate` failing on `origin/main`) is a `bug` `P1` issue `infra: main red — <failing test or error code>`, opened by the first session that sees it; while it is open no other Change is dispatched and only its fix is merged — a Change `fix-main-<issue>` whose issue the coordinator opens and whose session it offers. At the end of every wave, next to the architecture audit, the coordinator runs the retro: the `process` issues of the wave, summed up on the umbrella and grilled with the maintainer into a rule, a test or a setting.
